title: Black-white polynomials of graphs and generating functions
summary: Let G be a graph. The black-white polynomial W_G(t) enumerates colorings of the vertices of G with two colors (black and white), where the power of t keeps track of how many white vertices have an even number of black neighbors. Such polynomials appear in quantum information theory, where they are used to capture properties of the entanglement in certain quantum states described by graphs. In this paper we describe how to use generating functions to compute these polynomials for various families X of graphs.
